datasets.title: NGC 2392 in visible light
datasets.description: ESA/Hubble's photograph of NGC 2392, in He II 469, [O III] 502, H-alpha 656 and [N II] 658 nm. It lies on the walls the nebula's spectra give: a fast inner bubble pointed almost at the Sun inside a round outer shell (García-Díaz et al. 2012). A feature measured approaching is on the wall in front of the star, one receding on the wall behind it (García-Díaz et al. 2015).
datasets.summary: The photograph on the nebula's walls: a bubble inside a round shell, each feature on the side its measured speed gives.
